rows.ARS: White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Ludwig Taschner (South Africa, before 2001).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2001 as 'Snow Queen'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Strong fragrance. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Notes: Ludwigs Roses says Snow Queen is a sport of 'Bewitched' and its pure white blooms have the same shape and fragrance as its parent...
